purpose: Account of Alexey's phone-based remote development system

required_facts.fact: The author was traveling through Darmstadt, Amsterdam, Porto and family trips.
A permanent Linux server runs Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.
tmux keeps agent sessions alive through disconnects.
Production access is isolated from the remote machine.
An Android port-forwarding app was built in Kotlin.
Voice input uses Typeless and Google Recorder.
A temporary HTML picker reviewed 30 banner variants in five minutes.

author_attribution: This is Alexey's personal workflow; preserve Valeriia's editing contribution.
